User: Hey. Got something in the mail about missed calls?
Agent: Hey there, you probably saw one of our Dialux postcards. Yeah, we help small businesses stop losing leads from missed calls.

What kind of business are you running, and how are you currently handling calls when you’re busy or can’t pick up?
User: Oh hey, yeah - Dana Whitaker, me and my sister run Bright Smile Orthodontics up in Scottsdale. We got your thing in the mail. Look, I'm slammed between patients but our front desk keeps missing calls. Email's dana@brightsmileortho.com if that's easier. This cell you're on is fine, it's my best number actually. And we're Arizona, so like Mountain time I guess? Mornings before my first patient
Agent: Nice to meet you, Dana — Bright Smile Orthodontics in Scottsdale sounds busy in a good way.

Missing calls at the front desk is super common when you’re slammed. Are these mostly new patient inquiries you’re worried about missing, or existing patients calling about scheduling and emergencies?
User: Yep, mostly new patient inquiries and some scheduling issues. Mornings before my first patient are really the only good window.

Could you tell me:
1) The best callback number, with area code?  
2) Just to confirm, are you on Arizona time year‑round (no daylight savings)?
User: Already told ya - this cell is my best number. We're Arizona, so Mountain time I guess, no daylight savings.
